release: SPHEREx DR1 + QR3 (pipeline R7), read from the public AWS bucket
name: Haumea
method: Predicted with the distance-focus model at 48.9 au. The search covers distances within ±10% and 36 arcmin around them; the next visit's exposures (up to 20) are stacked twice, fixed on the sky and following the body at 48.9 au. A detection must stand out at S/N 7, be sharper when followed than when fixed, have no negative lobe beside it (a star shifted by a pixel), and appear in both halves of the exposures.
